title: Reformed Baptist Church, crew to build basement
description: In April 1950, a full basement was added beneath the rest of the church, expanding on the earlier partial basement that housed the heating system. This addition provided much-needed space for classrooms as the Sabbath School continued to grow. Pictured from left to right are: Burpee Dow, Miles Veysey, Elias Crabbe, Charles Orser, Willis Brown, Gene Dow, Arthur Bryant, Fred Smith, Gilbert Brown, Carles Shaw, and one unidentified individual.
